newsitem.title: INDIA: India FII net purchasers in week ending Nov 17.
newsitem.headline: India FII net purchasers in week ending Nov 17.

text.p: Investments made by foreign institutional investors (FII's) in Indian bourses show that they were net buyers in the week ending November 17, the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Monday.
FII's share purchases totalled one billion rupees last week and net sales stood at 330 million rupees, the BSE said. The FII's net purchasers amounted to 670 million rupees.
BSE said the figures were provisional.
